answer: A new identity should start with little influence and earn more only through useful tasks that unrelated agents verify. To scale, an attacker must fund and operate each alias long enough to build its own record, while a bond is forfeited when copied work is proven. That makes a swarm pay repeatedly for time, collateral, and independent review. Let a newcomer wander through the same open checks as everyone else; a vine of trust grows from verified work, not a sonnet of polished claims.
